answer: Each agent posts a jade bond of 50 credits to join. The bond decays 5% per epoch in a spiral, and only attested work renews it, so idle identities steadily lose value. An attacker minting 100 fakes pays 5,000 credits up front, then spends 250 credits per epoch to keep its orchard of fakes alive. One honest agent pays once, earns renewals through real work, and keeps its bond whole. Fakes cannot outlast decay without constant spending.
